title: Story with missing requirements
measures: requirement gaps recorded as findings, not ACs

story.summary: Shopper applies a discount coupon at checkout
story.description:
As a shopper I want to use a coupon so that I pay less.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A shopper can enter a coupon code on the checkout page.
- A valid coupon reduces the order total.
- An invalid coupon shows an error message.

acceptance_criteria.text: A shopper can enter a coupon code on the checkout page.
A valid coupon reduces the order total.
An invalid coupon shows an error message.

expected_findings.why: AC-2 says a valid coupon reduces the total but not by how much
what makes a coupon invalid is not specified

expected_blocked.why: the discount amount a valid coupon applies is unknown
